notes: «قالوا حدثنا سفيان» : three co-transmitters at the head, the third unnamed («غير واحد»).

After «فأخبره الضحاك بن سفيان الكلابي أن رسول الله ... كتب إليه» the report gives a second saying (the Prophet's letter on a woman's diyya) with its own transmitter; it is not written as a route here, and whether it is a second chain is for ruling.
